title: Understanding Python Linters through a Comprehensive and Systematic Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.35485v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code linters, tools that automatically detect code issues, help developers accelerate development and improve code quality by identifying errors early. Unlike previous studies that focused mainly on single linters or informal comparisons, this paper presents the first large-scale empirical study of five widely used Python linters: Ruff, Pylint, Flake8, Mypy and Black, through four key user concerns: linting rule checks, speed, configuration methods, and linter preferences. We analyze 1,551 linting rules, categorize them into five types, and construct rule mappings, finding that more than 40% are shared between multiple linters, with Ruff and Pylint together covering over 80% of all rules. Pylint has the most rules in the first two categories, and Ruff leads in the last three. Next, we measure their running times on 1,000 GitHub projects under three setups (single-rule, default, all-rules), finding a consistent speed ranking from fastest

translated_title: 通过全面且系统的实证研究理解Python代码检查工具
translated_abstract: 代码检查工具是能够自动检测代码问题的工具，通过尽早发现错误来帮助开发者加速开发并提升代码质量。与以往主要关注单一检查工具或非正式比较的研究不同，本文首次对五个广泛使用的Python检查工具：Ruff、Pylint、Flake8、Mypy和Black进行了大规模实证研究，研究围绕四个关键的用户关注点展开：检查规则、速度、配置方法以及检查工具偏好。我们分析了1,551条检查规则，将其归类为五种类型，并构建了规则映射关系，发现超过40%的规则被多个检查工具共享，其中Ruff和Pylint共同覆盖了超过80%的所有规则。Pylint在前两个规则类别中拥有最多的规则，而Ruff在后三个类别中处于领先地位。接着，我们在三种设置（单规则、默认、全部规则）下测量了这些工具在1,000个GitHub项目上的运行时间，发现其速度排名保持一致……
tldr: 本文首次对Ruff、Pylint、Flake8、Mypy和Black五个主流Python代码检查工具开展了大规模系统实证研究，从检查规则、速度、配置方法和工具偏好四个维度揭示了它们的共性、差异与特点。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first large-scale systematic empirical study of five widely used Python linters (Ruff, Pylint, Flake8, Mypy, and Black), revealing their similarities and differences across four key dimensions: linting rules, speed, configuration, and user preferences.
